ὑποπολλαπλάσῐος [πλᾰ], ον, of a number,
A.submultiple of another,
Nicom. Ar. 1.17 , 18 , 19 :—also ὑποπολλαπλᾰσῐ-επιμόριος , ον, submultiple-superparticular, i.e. contained in another number several times with one fractional part remaining:—and ὑποπολῑτ-επιμερής , ές, submultiple-superpartient, i.e. contained in another several times with two or more fractional parts remaining, ib. 1.17 , 21 (cf. 23 ).
From A Greek-English Lexicon (Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1940)
